description: This PHP source file defines the VueControllerHelper class, which provides helper methods for managing Vue.js related context data, menu items, user information, and permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with multiple services and traits to assemble configuration and state data for Vue components in the web application.

classes.name: VueControllerHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing Vue.js component context, including user info, menu items, permissions, theme data, and internationalization support within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the current Vue component instance.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Assembles and returns a dictionary of context parameters for Vue components, including user info, menu items, theme data, and localization.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Returns the current assets version based on build timestamp.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user's ID.

methods.name: getUserObject
methods.description: Builds and returns a representation of the current user's profile data including name and photo URL.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches the menu items for the current user and context.

methods.name: getContextItems
methods.description: Fetches the current screen's name and icon for context display.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of ScreenPermissionService.

methods.name: getBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds the breadcrumb navigation data based on the current module and screen.

methods.name: getThemeData
methods.description: Retrieves theme-related data such as logos and theme variables.

methods.name: getHelpUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the help page related to the current module and screen.
